meta.purpose: Per-contract-family news/data source map, 3 tiers (RELEASE / CONSENSUS / LEADING). Reachability actually tested through the session proxy (HTTP code shown). 'most-used by Kalshi counterparties' is partly unknowable (small venue, no trader survey) — ranked by canonical underlying-market importance + our own which-releases-move-the-market evidence.

RELEASE.name: EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report
RELEASE.reachability: page 302; API 200 with DEMO_KEY (returns actual values, 6896 rows deep)
RELEASE.load_bearing: HIGHEST energy — measured NG=F release-hour move 1.57x placebo, z=5.2
RELEASE.in_news_ingest: partial (EIA press yes; dedicated NGS report feed NO)

RELEASE.name: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report (crude/gasoline/distillate stocks)
RELEASE.cadence: weekly Wed 10:30 ET (Thu if Mon holiday)
RELEASE.reachability: weekly page 200; ir.eia.gov/wpsr/overview.html 403; API 200 with key
RELEASE.load_bearing: crude moves WTI modestly (CL=F 1.12x, daily z=2.15); largely pre-empted by API report
RELEASE.in_news_ingest: partial (EIA press/Today-in-Energy yes; WPSR data feed NO)

RELEASE.name: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO)
RELEASE.load_bearing: lower-frequency price-path guidance; secondary to weekly reports

CONSENSUS.name: ForexFactory calendar JSON (forecast/previous)
CONSENSUS.reachability: 200 — VERIFIED carries 'Crude Oil Inventories' forecast=-1.9M and 'Natural Gas Storage' forecast=60B
CONSENSUS.load_bearing: THE FREE ENERGY CONSENSUS UNLOCK — actual-minus-forecast surprise for both EIA reports. Limitation: no deep history, must poll weekly to accrue a surprise series.

CONSENSUS.name: API Weekly Statistical Bulletin (crude inventory, ~Tue 4:30 ET, PRE-EIA)
CONSENSUS.load_bearing: doubles as consensus AND leading indicator for crude — explains why EIA crude reaction is diffuse (API pre-empts). Capture via news_ingest headline parse.

CONSENSUS.name: TradingEconomics US energy calendar
CONSENSUS.reachability: 200 (calendar reachable; deep history limited to latest+next)

CONSENSUS.name: Reuters weekly natgas-storage / crude polls
CONSENSUS.load_bearing: canonical street consensus; obtainable only via news text

LEADING.name: API crude inventory (Tue night, before Wed EIA)
LEADING.load_bearing: strongest crude leading indicator; front-runs the EIA print

LEADING.name: NOAA GFS/NBM weather model runs (natgas demand)
LEADING.load_bearing: heating/cooling-degree-day outlook drives natgas ahead of storage

LEADING.name: Kpler / Vortexa / Genscape flows & storage
LEADING.load_bearing: real crude/product flows; institutional edge, not free

RELEASE.name: FOMC statement + SEP
RELEASE.load_bearing: HEAVIEST macro — ZN=F 5.1x, ES=F 3.0x release-hour vs placebo

RELEASE.name: BLS Employment Situation (Nonfarm Payrolls)
RELEASE.reachability: 403 bot-blocked via proxy (needs UA workaround / alt mirror)

RELEASE.name: BLS CPI
RELEASE.load_bearing: marquee rate event (literature ~ NFP); NOT measured here (no historical date list obtainable this session)

CONSENSUS.name: ForexFactory calendar JSON
CONSENSUS.load_bearing: THE FREE MACRO CONSENSUS UNLOCK. surprise = actual - forecast. Current-week only → accrue by polling.

CONSENSUS.name: TradingEconomics economic calendar
CONSENSUS.load_bearing: actual+forecast+prior columns; broader coverage, freemium limits on history

CONSENSUS.name: Investing.com / ForexFactory HTML calendars
CONSENSUS.reachability: 403 bot-blocked (both) — use the faireconomy JSON instead

LEADING.name: CME Fed Funds futures (ZQ=F) / SOFR — market-implied policy path
LEADING.load_bearing: prices the FOMC decision ahead of the statement

LEADING.name: ADP employment (Wed before NFP), jobless claims (weekly Thu)

RELEASE.name: NWS/ASOS station observation (the settlement ob)
RELEASE.load_bearing: HIGHEST — the ASOS daily max IS what temperature contracts settle on

CONSENSUS.name: NWS NDFD / NBM forecast (official expected high)
CONSENSUS.load_bearing: the 'forecast' the daily-high contract is priced against

LEADING.name: GFS / NBM model runs (NOMADS)
LEADING.load_bearing: traders update daily-high probability on each 00/06/12/18Z run

LEADING.name: ECMWF Open Data (IFS/AIFS)
LEADING.load_bearing: highest-skill global model; free open-data subset

RELEASE.name: ERCOT real-time fuel-mix / system load
RELEASE.load_bearing: RT grid state; settles/prices ERCOT contracts

CONSENSUS.name: ISO day-ahead forecast load & DA LMP
CONSENSUS.load_bearing: the expected-load baseline spikes are measured against

LEADING.name: ISO real-time load/price + weather models
LEADING.load_bearing: RT load ramp + temperature drive price-spike probability intraday
